scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w lyrics-service" "npm run dev -w control-ui" "npm run dev -w audience-ui" "npm run dev -w singer-ui"
scripts.check: node --check services/lyrics-service/server.js && node --check apps/control-ui/public/app.js && node --check apps/control-ui/public/edit.js && node --check apps/audience-ui/public/app.js && node --check apps/singer-ui/public/app.js && node --check config/load-env.js && node --check config/runtime.js && node --check config/static-ui-server.js
scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,3001,3002,4000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -ne 0 }; if ($ids) { $ids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } }; exit 0"
